lead.headline: No claim tonight; Barkley waits for Friday
lead.deck: Rice and Barkley have not practised, and Tuten's London kickoff makes the lineup tool's Barkley fallback impossible.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. You are 0-5, and your two best bench players have not practised: Rashee Rice's hamstring and Saquon Barkley's hamstring both wait for Wednesday's first report. The lineup tool wants both in on coin flips. Rice is easy — Pickens plays Sunday night, so he is a clean fallback at 12:55. Barkley is not: Tuten kicks off in London at 07:30, two hours before Barkley's inactives, so start Barkley only if Friday's report clears him. Claims close at 01:00 tonight and the wire offers nothing that beats a seat you can open; you are last in the order, so a claim would cost no place, but none earns one. Los Cachanillas project 79.2 with three starters on bye.
